name: Carfilzomib + Lenalidomide + Dexamethasone (KRd)

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: KRd is a proteasome-inhibitor/IMiD triplet and is not biomarker-restricted for eligibility. Cytogenetic risk (FISH for t(4;14), t(14;16), t(14;20), del(17p)/TP53, gain/amp 1q) informs risk stratification (R-ISS/R2-ISS), not access to KRd. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Multiple Myeloma, v5.2026.

treatmentSetting: primary therapy for newly diagnosed multiple myeloma (Other Recommended) and therapy for previously treated (relapsed) multiple myeloma

premedications.name: Carfilzomib hydration
premedications.notes: IV hydration before and after carfilzomib in early cycles to reduce tumor lysis/renal risk; dexamethasone premedication reduces infusion reactions.

supportiveCare: Carfilzomib: baseline and on-treatment cardiovascular monitoring (heart failure, hypertension, ischemia); hydration; VZV antiviral prophylaxis (proteasome inhibitor).
Lenalidomide: VTE thromboprophylaxis and REMS-program dispensing (teratogen); adjust for renal impairment.
Antiemetics: low emetic risk; prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier.
monitoring: CBC with differential and platelets before each cycle
renal function and electrolytes (lenalidomide clearance; carfilzomib TLS risk)

doseModificationRules.condition: new or worsening cardiac failure, ischemia, or grade 3 to 4 hypertension
doseModificationRules.text: Hold carfilzomib and evaluate cardiac function; resume at a reduced dose only after recovery per labeling; clinical review.

drugs.name: Carfilzomib
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., Table 74.6, p.1520 (line 286325). Carfilzomib is given at a reduced starting dose of 20 mg/m2 IV on Cycle 1 days 1 and 2, then escalated to 27 mg/m2 IV for all subsequent doses, on days 1, 2, 8, 9, 15, and 16 of a 28-day cycle (twice weekly). dosePerUnit reflects the 27 mg/m2 steady-state dose; the 20 mg/m2 Cycle 1 day 1 to 2 ramp is taken exactly as printed. A once-weekly 56 mg/m2 schedule (days 1, 8, 15; Cycle 1 day 1 = 20 mg/m2) is a source-stated alternative (Table 74.6 footnote b, line 286436). Ensure hydration and baseline cardiac assessment (carfilzomib cardiac/hypertension risk).

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: Chapter 74, Table 74.6 (Common Treatment Regimens in Multiple Myeloma), p.1520, KRd entry, line 286325 (Carfilzomib 20 mg/m2 (Cycle 1, day 1 and 2) and 27 mg/m2 (subsequent doses) IV on days 1, 2, 8, 9, 15, and 16)

drugs.name: Lenalidomide
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., Table 74.6, p.1520 (line 286326). Lenalidomide 25 mg PO on days 1 to 21 of a 28-day cycle. Requires VTE thromboprophylaxis and REMS-program dispensing (teratogen); reduce for renal impairment per CrCl.

drugs.name: Dexamethasone
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., Table 74.6, p.1520 (line 286327). Dexamethasone 40 mg PO on days 1, 8, and 15 of a 28-day cycle. Dose taken exactly as the source prints it.
